summary: Frontend testing completed for Student Messaging System in Portal del Alumno. Found and fixed 2 critical bugs: 1) ReferenceError: subjectId is not defined when clicking Mensajes tab, 2) ReferenceError: setActiveTab is not defined when clicking 'Enviar mensaje' button in teacher card. All features now working correctly.
passed_tests: Navigate to student dashboard showing 1 course, 1 classmate
Tab 'Mensajes' is visible in the course navigation tabs
Click on 'Mensajes' tab opens 3-column Gmail-like UI
Left column shows folders: Entrada (Inbox), Enviados (Sent), and 'Escribir al profesor' button
Center column shows message list (empty: 'Sin mensajes')
Right column shows message detail placeholder ('Selecciona un mensaje para leer')
Click 'Redactar' button opens compose modal with purple gradient header
Compose modal has: Para (recipients), Asunto (subject), Mensaje (body) fields
Recipient search shows teacher (Sonia Velasquez Romero - Profesor) and classmate (Juan Lopez Zapata - Compañero)
Teacher card in right sidebar shows 'Enviar mensaje' button
Click 'Enviar mensaje' in teacher card navigates to Mensajes tab
'Escribir al profesor' button opens compose modal with teacher pre-selected as recipient

bugs_fixed.fix: Changed courseId={subjectId} to courseId={courseId} in StudentMessagesContent component call

bugs_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: setActiveTab is not defined in DashboardContent
bugs_fixed.fix: Added onSendMessage prop to DashboardContent and updated button onClick to use onSendMessage callback

seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing student Pepito with course 'Histortia' (ID: a1eb013c-1682-4411-b525-334a55f588d5)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Student messaging system is fully working. Key implementation: 1) StudentMessagesContent component in StudentCourseDetailPage.jsx provides Gmail-like 3-column UI, 2) Tab 'Mensajes' added to STUDENT_TABS array, 3) Badge shows unread count from messageStats.unread, 4) 'Enviar mensaje' button in teacher card uses onSendMessage callback to switch to mensajes tab, 5) 'Escribir al profesor' button pre-fills teacher as recipient, 6) Backend endpoints /api/student-portal/messages/* handle inbox, sent, stats, allowed-recipients, and send operations.

gmail_like_ui.header: Purple gradient with 'Mensajes' title and 'Redactar' button

teacher_card_button.location: Right sidebar in course detail page

escribir_al_profesor.action: Opens compose modal with teacher pre-selected

recipient_restriction.description: Student can only message teacher and classmates in same section
